system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: `instructions` can be a **function** instead of a string. The function receives the current `RunContext` and the Agent instance and can return a string _or_ a `Promise<string>`.
system_prompt_style.note: Default is a user-supplied static/dynamic instructions string; SandboxAgent adds base_instructions and AGENTS.md custom instructions per the announcement.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Agents paired with a filesystem workspace and sandbox environment for longer-running work
env_context_strategy.note: Sandbox agent explores via shell/apply_patch tools; a Manifest defines mounted entries.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: It now has configurable memory, sandbox-aware orchestration, Codex-like filesystem tools
context_compaction.evidence_locator: paper: The next evolution of the Agents SDK, 'A more capable harness for the agent loop'
context_compaction.note: Memory generation is enqueued in runner/sandbox.ts (enqueueMemoryGeneration); no explicit truncation code seen in evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Sandbox execution: Run agents with isolated filesystem workspaces, shell commands, file editing, snapshots, and sandbox session state when the work needs a workspace.
observation_format.note: Computer-use tools exist (disposeResolvedComputers in runner/sandbox.ts) which could add screenshots, but not shown in evidence.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Function tools: Turn any TypeScript function into a tool with automatic schema generation and schema-based validation.
tool_call_format.note: Tool calls arrive as protocol.FunctionCallItem via the Responses API; shell and applyPatch actions are separate processedResponse categories (runner/runLoop.ts).

tool_count.note: Tools are user-supplied; SandboxAgent capabilities list not visible in provided evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: file edits using the apply patch⁠(opens in a new window) tool
edit_primitive.evidence_locator: paper: The next evolution of the Agents SDK, 'A more capable harness for the agent loop'
edit_primitive.note: applyPatchActions appear in the run loop's processed response categories.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Function tools: Turn any TypeScript function into a tool with automatic schema generation and schema-based validation.
tool_schema_source.note: MCP servers also supply schemas via `mcpServers`/getAllMcpTools (agent.ts imports).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: MCP server tool calling: Built-in integration that exposes tools from MCP servers to agents alongside function tools.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Agent loop: A built-in agent loop that handles tool invocation, sends results back to the LLM, and continues until the task is complete.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Agent loop: A built-in agent loop that handles tool invocation, sends results back to the LLM, and continues until the task is complete.
planning_granularity.note: No plan object registered in the run loop evidence; planning would be in the prompt only.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Agents as tools and handoffs, which allow agents to delegate to other agents for specific tasks
multi_agent_topology.note: Default agent is single; orchestrator_workers (agents as tools) and role handoffs are reachable by configuration.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: | `handoffs` | no | Delegate the conversation to specialist agents.
delegation_mechanism.note: Optional field; when set, role_handoff (handoffs) or subagent_spawn (agent.asTool nested runs) are reachable.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Whether invoking this tool requires approval, matching the behavior of {@link tool} helpers.
human_in_loop.note: Per-tool needsApproval yields RunToolApprovalItem interruptions; off unless configured.

short_term_state.note: RunState carries _currentStep, _generatedItems, _conversationId, _lastProcessedResponse beyond the message list.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: progressive disclosure via skills⁠(opens in a new window), custom instructions via AGENTS.md
long_term_memory.evidence_locator: paper: The next evolution of the Agents SDK, 'A more capable harness for the agent loop'
long_term_memory.note: Paper describes Python-first harness; sandbox memory generation exists in runner/sandbox.ts.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: With built-in snapshotting and rehydration, the Agents SDK can restore the agent’s state in a fresh container and continue from the last checkpoint if the original environment fails or expires.
state_persistence.evidence_locator: paper: The next evolution of the Agents SDK, 'Separating harness from compute for security, durability, and scale'
state_persistence.note: Code: prepareSandboxInterruptedTurnResume / resumeAcceptedModelResponse in packages/agents-core/src/runner/sandbox.ts and runLoop.ts.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Guardrails: Run input validation and safety checks in parallel with agent execution, and fail fast when checks do not pass.
self_verification.note: Guardrails are user-authored validators, not harness-run tests, linters or judges; none enabled by default.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Agent loop: A built-in agent loop that handles tool invocation, sends results back to the LLM, and continues until the task is complete.

rollback.evidence_quote: Sandbox agents, which pair agents with isolated filesystem workspaces, shell commands, file editing, snapshots, and sandbox session state
